summary: Serve **OpenAPI 3.1** (`/api/v1/openapi.yaml`), **open read-only Swagger UI** (`/api/v1/docs` without live data queries), **route sync test** (§10.1.6), **`docs/api.md`**, **fat JAR**, `scripts/deploy-*.sh`, and GitHub **CI + deploy** workflows (fixing `app/webApp/**` path filter and NFR-01 wasm bundle size check).
overview:
Closing **Fase 1 base** delivery artifacts: external clients and Astro get a verified OpenAPI 3.1 contract, operators get a readable Swagger UI without Bearer friction, and `main` deploys safely only when all tests pass.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §6.1, §8 (NFR-01), §9.2–9.5, §10.1.6 · `docs/decisiones.md`.

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-server-infra` (`GET /api/health`, `ENABLE_API_DOCS` defaulting to `true`).
- `platform-server-auth` (`/api/v1/auth/*`, `/api/v1/me*`).
- Every subsequent feature slice updates `openapi.yaml` in the same PR (enforced by `OpenApiRouteSyncTest`).

**OpenAPI & Swagger UI policy (`decisiones.md`)**
- File: `server/src/main/resources/openapi/openapi.yaml` (OpenAPI **3.1.0**), served publicly at `GET /api/v1/openapi.yaml`.
- **Swagger UI (`GET /api/v1/docs`)** is **publicly open by default** (`ENABLE_API_DOCS=true`, can be toggled off via env) and configured as **read-only documentation** (`supportedSubmitMethods: []`) so anyone can browse the contract cleanly without needing a browser Bearer token and without executing live queries against real colla data.
- `OpenApiRouteSyncTest` validates YAML syntax + OpenAPI 3.1 structure and checks 1:1 parity between Ktor-registered API routes and paths/methods in `openapi.yaml` (excluding static Swagger UI assets and `/openapi.yaml`/`/docs` themselves).

**Deploy & CI policy (Tabala paths)**
- Fat JAR: `./gradlew :server:buildFatJar` → `server/build/libs/server-all.jar`.
- Webapp: `./gradlew :app:webApp:wasmJsBrowserDistribution -PapiBaseUrl=https://api.muixerangadelx.com/api/v1` → `app/webApp/build/dist/wasmJs/productionExecutable/`.
- CI measures and logs wasm distribution transferred size against the NFR-01 15 MB guideline.
- Path filters in `deploy-web.yml` watch `app/webApp/**`, `app/shared/**`, `core/**` (not `webApp/**`).
- Secrets: `DEPLOY_HOST`, `DEPLOY_SSH_KEY`, `DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS` only — never `JWT_SECRET`.

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `GET /api/v1/openapi.yaml` returns `200` valid OpenAPI 3.1 YAML.
- `GET /api/v1/docs` returns `200` Swagger UI HTML with `supportedSubmitMethods: []` when `ENABLE_API_DOCS=true` (and `404` when `ENABLE_API_DOCS=false`).
- `OpenApiRouteSyncTest` passes in `:server:test` and fails if a route is missing from `openapi.yaml` or vice versa.
- `scripts/deploy-server.sh` (prunes releases keeping last 5, never deleting active target) and `scripts/deploy-web.sh` exist and are executable.
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `deploy-server.yml`, and `deploy-web.yml` match Tabala module paths and v1 scope (no Android block for v1).
- `docs/api.md` documents external client flow (`client: "native"`, OAuth Playground, `curl` examples).
shared_ui_policy: No Compose UI. Vendored Swagger UI static assets are served by `:server` at `/api/v1/docs`.
out_of_scope:
- Implementing new business REST endpoints (only document currently registered routes).
- Full §10.1.1 permission matrix for future feature routes (each feature slice adds its own permission-matrix tests for all roles).
- Editing VPS Caddyfile or systemd unit (§9.4 reference only).
- Android/desktop CI builds (deferred out of v1).
- Astro site deployment.

external_systems.role: PR/push CI checks + automated SSH deploy on `main` when tests pass.

external_systems.name: VPS (Netcup / Debian 13)
external_systems.role: Target for `deploy-server.sh` and `deploy-web.sh`; health poll at `https://api.muixerangadelx.com/api/health`.

auth.server: `GET /api/v1/openapi.yaml` is public. `GET /api/v1/docs` is publicly open when `ENABLE_API_DOCS=true` (default) in read-only mode (`supportedSubmitMethods: []`) so it never queries real data.

components.name: openapi.yaml
components.usage: Authoritative OpenAPI 3.1.0 specification covering all implemented endpoints (`/api/health`, `/api/v1/auth/*`, `/api/v1/me*`) and reusable schemas (`ApiErrorResponse`, `PagedResponse`, `FileRef`, `UserSelf`, etc.).
components.notes: Expanded by every subsequent feature slice in the same PR.

components.name: OpenApiRoutes + vendored Swagger UI
components.usage: Serve `/api/v1/openapi.yaml` (`application/yaml`) and vendored static Swagger UI at `/api/v1/docs` (pinned version under `server/src/main/resources/swagger-ui/`, configured with `url: '/api/v1/openapi.yaml'` and `supportedSubmitMethods: []`).

components.name: OpenApiRouteSyncTest
components.usage: Validate OpenAPI 3.1 YAML schema structure and assert exact parity between Ktor-registered API `(METHOD, normalizedPath)` pairs and `openapi.yaml` operations.
components.notes: Excludes static Swagger assets and doc self-routes.

components.name: server/build.gradle.kts
components.usage: Configure Ktor `fatJar { archiveFileName.set("server-all.jar") }` and ensure Flyway `.sql`, `openapi.yaml`, and `swagger-ui/` assets are packaged in the JAR.

components.name: deploy-server.sh & deploy-web.sh
components.usage: Executable bash scripts with `set -euo pipefail`: verify artifact exists, `scp`/`rsync`, symlink & `systemctl restart`, health poll loop (`30 × 2s`), and release pruning (keep newest 5 without deleting active symlink target).

components.name: CI & Deploy workflows
components.usage: Update `ci.yml` (`:core:jvmTest`, `:server:test`, `:app:shared:jvmTest`, `:app:webApp:wasmJsBrowserDistribution` + NFR-01 size report); create `deploy-server.yml` (`server/**`, `core/**`) and `deploy-web.yml` (`app/webApp/**`, `app/shared/**`, `core/**`).

components.name: docs/api.md
components.usage: Quick-start guide for external API consumers (Astro, scripts, future mobile apps): OpenAPI/Swagger URLs, obtaining a Google ID token via OAuth 2.0 Playground, `curl` examples for `/auth/google` (`native`), `/auth/refresh`, and authenticated calls.

structure:
Documentation & delivery pipeline:

```text
PR / Push
  → .github/workflows/ci.yml
      ├─ ./gradlew :core:jvmTest :server:test :app:shared:jvmTest
      ├─ OpenApiRouteSyncTest (inside :server:test)
      └─ ./gradlew :app:webApp:wasmJsBrowserDistribution + measure bundle size (NFR-01)

Push to main (server/** or core/**)
  → deploy-server.yml → :server:test → :server:buildFatJar → scripts/deploy-server.sh

Push to main (app/webApp/**, app/shared/**, or core/**)
  → deploy-web.yml → :app:shared:jvmTest → wasmJsBrowserDistribution → scripts/deploy-web.sh

Runtime
  GET /api/v1/openapi.yaml → classpath openapi/openapi.yaml
  GET /api/v1/docs         → vendored Swagger UI (read-only, supportedSubmitMethods: [])
```

sections.title: Read-only public Swagger UI (`decisiones.md`)
sections.description: Vendor pinned `swagger-ui-dist` assets (`swagger-ui-bundle.js`, `swagger-ui.css`, `index.html`) under `server/src/main/resources/swagger-ui/` so `/api/v1/docs` has zero third-party CDN dependencies.
sections.behavior: Initialize Swagger UI with `url: '/api/v1/openapi.yaml'`, `supportedSubmitMethods: []` (disables interactive Try-it-out so no real data queries happen from docs), and `validatorUrl: null`. Controlled by `ENABLE_API_DOCS` (default `true`).

sections.title: OpenApiRouteSyncTest parity rules (§10.1.6)
sections.description: Introspect Ktor's `RoutingRoot` tree inside `testApplication` and parse `openapi.yaml` with a YAML/OpenAPI parser (e.g. `snakeyaml` or `swagger-parser` in `testImplementation`).
sections.behavior: Verify `openapi` starts with `3.1.`, verify every registered API `(METHOD, path)` exists in `openapi.yaml`, and verify every operation in `openapi.yaml` exists in Ktor (excluding `/api/v1/openapi.yaml`, `/api/v1/docs`, and static asset routes). Fail with an explicit diff listing missing/extra operations.

sections.title: Safe deployment & rollback (§9.3)
sections.description: `scripts/deploy-server.sh` requires `DEPLOY_HOST`, checks `server/build/libs/server-all.jar` exists, uploads to `/opt/muixeranga/releases/app-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.jar`, updates `/opt/muixeranga/app.jar`, restarts `muixeranga`, polls `https://api.muixerangadelx.com/api/health` up to 60 s, and prunes older jars keeping the 5 most recent (never deleting the active symlink target).
sections.behavior: Exit non-zero immediately if any step or health poll fails. Document one-line manual rollback (`ln -sfn /opt/muixeranga/releases/<prev>.jar /opt/muixeranga/app.jar && sudo systemctl restart muixeranga`) in `docs/api.md`.
